user.title: Booking system
user.description: Mint the token in the booking system: Admin → Settings → Home Assistant. A fresh install starts in dry-run: nothing is written to the lock until you switch it off in the options.

data_description.lock_entity: A lock paired directly over Matter

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The booking system at {url} refused the token. Mint a new one in Admin → Settings → Home Assistant.

data.site_access_token: Site access token (staging only; empty keeps the current one)

error.cannot_connect: No valid answer from the booking system
error.invalid_site_token: The site gate refused the request: check the site access token
error.https_required: The address must start with https://
error.unsupported_api: The booking system speaks an API version this integration does not know

abort.already_configured: This booking system is already configured

data.dry_run_report: In dry-run, still report code status to the booking system
data.slot_limit: Booking codes on the lock at once

data_description.dry_run: Everything runs except writing to the lock and reporting; each planned operation is logged and fired as an event. Switching it on removes the booking codes already on the lock.
data_description.dry_run_report: Only for a staging booking system: it will believe the codes are on the lock.
data_description.slot_limit: The rest of the lock's users stay free for codes made by hand

recordings.title: Recordings
recordings.description: Recordings are uploaded only for bookings with the client's opt-in, at night, through the camera bridges (a74_bridge). The storage keys need read, write and delete rights on the bucket the bridges upload to.

data.delete_sources: Delete from the cards and the console disk after upload

data_description.guard_entity: On while a take is being recorded. Its changes make the take journal; uploads never run while it is on.
data_description.s3_access_key: Leave empty to keep the stored key
data_description.s3_secret_key: Leave empty to keep the stored key
data_description.s3_root: Each booking gets its own subfolder with a random part
data_description.download_days: After that the files are deleted from the bucket. Signed links cannot live longer than 7 days.
data_description.delete_sources: Once every file of a session is in the bucket with the right size and the link is reported, its files are removed from the camera cards and the console disk. Only those files; nothing is formatted.

presets.title: Camera presets
presets.description: When a booking's code window opens, the cameras get the client's preset (named after the booking's entity, e.g. klient-studio-xyz). When the client leaves, changed settings are saved back to it. A client without a preset gets a copy of the reference preset. Needs a74_bridge 0.8.0 or newer. Nothing is loaded or saved while recording mode is on.

data_description.preset_reference: A name from the a74_bridge preset library. Also loaded for bookings without an entity name.

error.storage_incomplete: Fill in the endpoint, the bucket and both keys before switching the pipeline on
error.storage_refused: The storage refused the keys or cannot be reached
error.bridge_missing: a74_bridge 0.8.0 or newer is not set up (its preset_status action is missing)
error.reference_missing: No such preset in the a74_bridge library

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Fetch the bookings and reconcile the lock right away, e.g. after regenerating a PIN in the booking system.

reconcile_lock.name: Reconcile lock
reconcile_lock.description: Read the lock and fix differences without asking the booking system.

revoke_code.name: Revoke code
revoke_code.description: Take a booking's code off the lock now without cancelling the booking. The code returns only after its PIN is regenerated.

set_recording_opt_in.name: Set recording opt-in
set_recording_opt_in.description: Record the client's choice about uploading the recordings. Fails once the upload has started.

opt_in.name: Upload recordings
opt_in.description: Whether the recordings should be uploaded.

report_recording.name: Report recording
report_recording.description: Report upload progress to the booking system, which sends the e-mails.

url.name: Download link
url.description: https link for the client; required for ready.

expires_at.name: Link expires at
expires_at.description: Required for ready; must be in the future.

resolve_recordings.name: Resolve recordings
resolve_recordings.description: The operator's decision about recordings left on the cards or the console disk after a session.

action.name: Decision
action.description: upload: opt in on the client's behalf and send them next night; keep: ask again tomorrow; delete: remove the session's files from the cards and the console disk as soon as nobody is in.

run_recordings.name: Run recording pass
run_recordings.description: Run one pass of the recording pipeline now instead of waiting for the next minute. All safety conditions still apply.
